# Evidence — 018's manual gate, 2026-08-15

Screenshots and one process sample from the first full run of `018-transaction-list`'s
release-blocking manual gate (G1–G8, G10). They are cited by the tickets in `../issues/`.

**Everything here is synthetic.** The corpus was generated by `make perf-corpus` — eight
statements of 1,250 rows each, every row a `SYNTHETIC MERCHANT NNNNN` with a made-up amount.
No real statement, and no fragment of one, appears in any of these images (Constitution I).

Run on iPhone 16 simulator, iOS 26.5, Debug build, Dark Mode.

| File | Cited by | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `g1-amounts-at-largest-type.png` | `issues/01` | G1 passing — amounts render in full at `accessibility-XXXL`, both directions, no ellipsis |
| `g4-heading-carries-the-year-2025.png` | `issues/01` | G4 passing — `28 December 2025` carries the year; current-year headings do not |
| `g5-filter-chrome-and-clipped-row-xxxl.png` | `issues/02`, `issues/03` | **Both failures in one frame** — the scope chip reduced to `ICIC…` over `·····…`, the clear button broken as `Show all ac-count s`, and a row's `−₹2,518.21` sliced mid-glyph by the bar |
| `g6-reduce-transparency-menu-vs-rows.png` | `issues/04` | The discriminator, side by side — the **menu** reads `…, ending 7742` and `…, ending 1002` in full while the **rows** behind it read `…endin…` and `…ending 90…`. Also G6 passing: chrome solid, no text on text |
| `g7-increase-contrast-dark-mode.png` | `issues/01`, `issues/04` | G7 passing — direction carried by a leading `+`/`−`, never colour. Also shows the row's `, endin…` truncation at the **default** text size |
| `hang-front-door-at-100-percent-cpu.png` | `issues/05` | The frozen front door |
| `hang-sample.txt.gz` | `issues/05` | ⚠️ **The load-bearing artefact.** `sample` over 3 s: 1217 of 1217 main-thread samples inside one `CATransaction::commit` → `_UIHostingView.layoutSubviews` → `DisplayList.ViewUpdater.updateInheritedView`. Read it before attempting a reproduction — it is what rules out the engine, PDFKit and the import path. `gunzip -c hang-sample.txt.gz \| less` |
